title: mail: Email/query implementation
description:
Implement Email/query in crates/mail/src/email/query.rs: filter by inMailbox (required; maps to group name via Mailbox id), optional filter by after/before (date range), from, subject (substring). Query OverviewStore.query_range() for the group, apply filters, sort by date desc. Return QueryResponse with ids (CID strings), position, total, queryState.

Why: clients use Email/query to list messages in a folder; this is the most frequently called method.

Acceptance: after posting 3 articles to comp.test, Email/query for comp.test returns 3 ids; date-range filter returns correct subset.
